from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,importlib.util,json
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
root=Path.cwd().resolve();name='diag_test_s16_s04_unsealed_archive_01'
parent,pref=audited_result(root/'results/gen_test_s16_round2_s04.json')
account,aref=audited_result(root/'results/diag_gen_test_s16_s04_accounting_01.json')
assert parent['_meta']['end'] and account['_meta']['exit_code']==0 and account['metrics']['complete_allocation_accounting'] is True
jobs=[x for x in account['config']['jobs'] if x['job_id']=='709455.hopper-m-02']
assert len(jobs)==1 and jobs[0]['qstat_exit']==0 and jobs[0]['fields']['job_state']=='F'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original_s04_audit',root/'scripts/audit_provenance.py')
audit=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(audit)
out=root/'logs/review'/name;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
rows=[];stored=[]
def preserve(source,destination,expected=None):
 body=source.read_bytes();sha=hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
 if expected is not None:assert sha==expected,(source,'original declared SHA changed')
 target=out/destination;target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
 with target.open('xb') as stream:stream.write(body)
 assert target.read_bytes()==body and source.read_bytes()==body
 item={'original_file':str(source),'archive_file':str(target.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha,'bytes':len(body),'byte_identical':True}
 stored.append(item);return item
for scene in (426,425,226,326):
 run=f'gen_test_s16_round2_s04_c6_floorplan{scene}'
 raw=root/'results'/(run+'.json');data=json.loads(raw.read_bytes())
 assert data['config']['scene']==f'FloorPlan{scene}' and data['config']['name']==run and '_meta' not in data
 source_rows=[x for x in parent['metrics']['scene_runs'] if x['run_name']==run]
 assert len(source_rows)==1;declared=source_rows[0]
 assert declared['result_path']=='results/'+run+'.json' and declared.get('provenance_error')
 artifacts=[preserve(raw,Path('raw/results')/raw.name),preserve(root/'logs/runs'/(run+'.log'),Path('raw/logs')/(run+'.log'))]
 launcher=Path(declared['launcher_log'])
 artifacts.append(preserve(launcher,Path('raw/launchers')/launcher.name,declared['launcher_log_sha256']))
 absent=[]
 for suffix in ('.meta.json','.diff'):
  p=root/'logs/runs'/(run+suffix)
  if p.exists():artifacts.append(preserve(p,Path('raw/logs')/p.name))
  else:absent.append(str(p.relative_to(root)))
 audit_report=audit.audit_file(str(raw));assert audit_report['fail']
 rows.append({'scene':f'FloorPlan{scene}','run_name':run,'original_status':data['metrics'].get('status'),'original_error':data['metrics'].get('error'),'original_cleanup_errors':data['metrics'].get('cleanup_errors'),'original_meta_present':False,'original_audit':audit_report,'parent_declared_scene_run':declared,'archived_artifacts':artifacts,'missing_original_files':absent})
report={'scope':'Lossless preservation of originally unsealed failed child evidence only; no source repair, independent pass, cache or training authorization.',
 'parent':pref,'canonical_accounting':aref,'pbs_final_fields':jobs[0]['fields'],
 'allocation_ended_by_original_pbs':True,
 'per_process_cleanup_confirmed':None,
 'cleanup_scope':'Original PBS job_state F and obittime authenticate allocation end. They do not repair the missing child identity/cleanup proofs or independently confirm every native PID disappeared.',
 'original_parent_cleanup_errors':parent['metrics']['cleanup_errors'],
 'original_admission_final':parent['metrics'].get('admission_final'),
 'children':rows,'artifacts':stored,'original_records_modified':False}
for item in stored:
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(item['original_file']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
with (out/'manifest.json').open('x') as stream:json.dump(report,stream,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False);stream.write('\n')
text=['# S04 original unsealed evidence archive','',report['scope'],'',report['cleanup_scope'],'','Original parent cleanup errors:']
text += ['- '+x for x in report['original_parent_cleanup_errors']]
text += ['','| Scene | Original error | Original audit |','|---|---|---|']
text += ['| '+r['scene']+' | '+str(r['original_error'])+' | FAIL retained; _meta absent |' for r in rows]
text += ['','No original result, log, metadata or failure status was modified.']
with (out/'report.md').open('x') as stream:stream.write('\n'.join(text)+'\n')
manifest=out/'manifest.json'
print('S04_UNSEALED_ARCHIVE_JSON: '+json.dumps({'manifest':{'file':str(manifest.relative_to(root)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(manifest.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},'pbs_job_state':jobs[0]['fields']['job_state'],'allocation_gpu_hours':account['metrics']['total_allocation_gpu_hours'],'queue_wait_seconds':jobs[0]['queue_wait_seconds'],'archived_scene_names':[r['scene'] for r in rows],'original_parent_cleanup_errors':report['original_parent_cleanup_errors'],'per_process_cleanup_confirmed':None,'original_records_modified':False},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
